description: Change one or more of your Besidka preferences: reasoningExpanded, reasoningAutoHide, defaultReasoningLevel (null clears it), favoriteModels, favoriteGatewayModels, sidebarPinned, memoryEnabled and chatSearchEnabled. Each value replaces the previous one: favoriteModels and favoriteGatewayModels are replaced as a whole, so read get_settings first and send the full list or map. Automatic memory extraction, memory models, TypeSafe AI roles, the about-me text and consents cannot be changed through MCP. Requires signing in (settings:write).
name: update_settings
title: Change my settings
